title: First Aid Paper 5: Fractures, Shock and Emergency Care
source: Adapted from user-provided First Aid and Nursing question banks

objective.question: First aid is the immediate action taken to:
options: Care for the injured until medical help is available
objective.explanation: First aid cares until help arrives.

objective.question: Which of the following is not a characteristic of good dressing?
options: Equal to the diameter of the wound
objective.explanation: Dressing should extend beyond the wound.

objective.question: After confirming the scene is safe, which immediate assessment priority follows the primary-survey sequence?
options: Open and assess the airway while protecting the cervical spine
Control a minor bleed before checking airway
Determine the exact mechanism of injury before assessment
objective.explanation: After scene safety, the primary survey follows an airway-first approach (with spinal protection when indicated), followed by breathing and circulation. Catastrophic external bleeding may require immediate control in current XABCDE protocols.

objective.question: Which step in emergency care should be taken first?
The condition where one gets reduced blood flow to the brain is called:
objective.explanation: Fainting is reduced brain blood flow.

objective.question: Which of the following is used to immobilize a fracture?
A first aider involved in the look, listen and feel process is:
objective.explanation: Look, listen and feel checks breathing.

structured.question: Explain five important items found in first aid kit and their use. (10 marks)
structured.modelAnswer: Dressings, bandages, gloves, antiseptic and scissors with uses.

structured.question: Explain factors to consider before deciding on means of transporting a casualty. (10 marks)
markingGuide: Factors such as distance and severity: 10 marks.
structured.modelAnswer: Nature of injury, distance, transport and safety.

structured.question: Explain the five components of the nursing process. (10 marks)
markingGuide: Assessment, diagnosis, planning, implementation, evaluation: 10 marks.

structured.question: Give and explain the first aid management for nose bleeding. (10 marks)
structured.modelAnswer: Sit forward, pinch nose, monitor and refer.

structured.question: Define haemorrhage and explain classification and management of minor lower limb bleeding. (20 marks)
structured.modelAnswer: Haemorrhage is blood loss; arterial, venous, capillary; direct pressure and dressing.
